judge_input.description:
Example Output:

```
$ bao lease lookup certificates/issue/example-dot-com/JPmYJPmnB1RgGLN5FpjMGEtj.ZoG8sM
Key               Value
---               -----
expire_time       2025-10-12T10:31:14.000106371+02:00
id                certificates/issue/example-dot-com/JPmYJPmnB1RgGLN5FpjMGEtj.ZoG8sM
issue_time        2025-10-09T10:31:14.34655468+02:00
last_renewal      <nil>
namespace_path    ns1/ns2/
path              certificates/issue/example-dot-com
renewable         false
ttl               71h59m45s
```

There is a particular security consideration that is genuinely worth taking a moment to raise here and think carefully about: is it, in actual fact, truly safe for us to go right ahead and openly display the revoke error in the way being described? The underlying concern behind asking that is the worry that this error could, at least in principle, potentially end up containing within it some manner of sensitive information (although, just to be completely clear and fair about the whole thing, it really and truly should not ever end up doing that at all, and the particular reason for that is simply because the error is, in any case, going to end up getting itself logged regardless of anything else, in any case).

See also, for any further reference and context on all of this whole matter, the closely related issue that can be found over at https://github.com/openbao/openbao/issues/1895
